Side = 7, so the hexagon's perimeter is 6 × 7 = 42 inches. The proposed answer of 126 is wrong.

The error is the claim that each triangle's side is one-sixth of the hexagon's perimeter. That part is actually true: side = P_h/6. But the solution then writes P_t = P_h/6, which sets the triangle's whole perimeter, not its side, equal to one-sixth of the hexagon's perimeter. That mistake leads to P_h = 18s instead of the correct P_h = 6s.

VERDICT: REJECT
